response.overview: There is someone who always envy the comfortable lives of others—jealous of those who are already successful or wealthy, envious of people who can freely hang out with friends, and also envious of those who have a partner.  What if there comes a time when he becomes the person he has always envied, only to realize that it is not as great as it seemed? He then comes to understand that there is no need to compare his life with others, as there might be hidden conflicts behind a life that looks pleasant.
response.title: Mereka Bahagia, Katanya
